steps.title: A window
steps.say: Make a hole in the wall and fill it with glass. This one is 3 wide and 2 high.
steps.tip: Glass panes are thinner than glass blocks, so the window looks set into the wall.

steps.title: Shutters
steps.say: Put trapdoors on the wall on each side of the window, two high. Open them, and they look like shutters.
steps.tip: A trapdoor sticks to the block you point at. Tap it to open or shut it.

steps.title: A ledge under it
steps.say: Put trapdoors under the window and leave them shut. Point high on the wall, so they sit at the top of the space.
steps.tip: Point at the top half of a block's side, and the trapdoor goes at the top.

steps.title: A little roof
steps.say: Put a row of stairs above the window, against the wall, like a little roof.
steps.tip: Use the same wood for the shutters and the roof, so they go together.
